messages:
Noah: heads-up, new co-sell pilot with Aurora Telecom. They want a 4-week POC, SAML SSO, telemetry export, and an estimated cost for 50k requests/day. Need a short runbook and security answers for their vendor questionnaire.

Priya: thanks Noah. Can you confirm avg tokens per request? 50k/day is huge if responses are long.

Ivy (Aurora): most calls are short assistant replies, estimate ~600 tokens roundtrip on average. Goal is throughput testing not long-form. We'll provide SAML metadata and the questionnaire PDFs.

Carl: quick calc: 50k * 600 = 30M tokens/day -> ~900M/month. Hosted pricing at public list (~$0.00035/token) -> ~315k/mo. If we do Dedicated reserved there are VM+GPU costs but per-token falls significantly; need to know concurrency and peak qps.

Sam: for SAML we need IdP metadata. Onboarding flow: 1) exchange metadata 2) spin dev tenant + API key 3) run smoke traffic and validate telemetry 4) perf test and adjust caches. I can draft a 1-page runbook and include sample SAML snippet. ETA 24h.

Priya: RevOps note 1: for co-sell pilots we often set a consumption cap and offer a 50% pilot discount for first month. Need billing owner (partner vs customer).

Ivy (Aurora): partner will be billing owner. They need telemetry in gzip JSON to S3 every 6h and webhook for failures. Retention 60 days.

Sam: OK we can support S3 dumps + webhook. Telemetry fields we include: request_id, model, status, latency_ms, user_hash, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens. We'll confirm schema in onboarding doc.

Noah: security questionnaire will be reviewed by Carl and infra. deploy-bot linked the partner runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-pilot-checklist. Attachments please upload to the shared drive.

Carl: op note 1: to hit p95 <150ms we'll recommend Dedicated with A10x or similar and KV prefix caching. Otherwise Hosted expected p95 ~250-400ms under load. Also recommend a small prompt rewrite to save tokens; I'll draft example.

Ivy (Aurora): great, sending metadata and questionnaire now. We'll aim to start next Mon.

Priya: action items: Sam runbook (24h), Carl perf & prompt rewrite (EOD), RevOps quote with pilot discount (tomorrow). Noah will coordinate kickoff. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: draft runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/co-sell-aurora-pilot-draft.pdf
